newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one Sept 12.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on September 12:
WASHINGTON - The United States prepared for air strikes against Iraq after U.S. jets were fired on by Iraq.
WASHINGTON - Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole held a rally for Republicans in Congress, telling them not to worry about this election.
WASHINGTON - The U.S. Navy and Air Force are jockeying for a bigger role in Iraq to justify future budgets.
WASHINGTON - President Clinton's advertising campaign emphasises the risks of voting for Bob Dole.
WASHINGTON - Feuding gangs in Washington are terrorising residents of a Washington neighborhood.
